commerceConnect.seoDescription: Register your business and list your offers on Vitanaland with Claude: in minutes, without forms.
commerceConnect.title: Connect Vitanaland to Claude
commerceConnect.lead: Tell Claude what your business offers. Claude sets up your business on Vitanaland, adds your products and services as drafts, and walks you through the remaining steps.
commerceConnect.step1Body: In Claude, open Settings, then Connectors, and search for Vitanaland. If it is not listed, add a custom connector with the address above.
commerceConnect.step2Title: Sign in with your Vitanaland account
commerceConnect.step2Body: You sign in to Vitanaland and allow Claude to work on your business. You never give Claude a password.
commerceConnect.step3Body: For example, share your website. Claude works out what it can and only asks for what it cannot know.
commerceConnect.canDoTitle: What Claude can do for you
commerceConnect.canDo1: إنشاء عملك التجاري وملء تفاصيل الشركة
commerceConnect.canDo3: تشغيل الفحوصات التلقائية وإخبارك بما لا يزال مفقودًا
commerceConnect.canDo5: تقديم عملك التجاري للمراجعة بعد الموافقة
commerceConnect.stays1: الموافقة على شروط الشراكة على Vitanaland، وليس عبر Claude أبدًا.
commerceConnect.stays2: بعض الخطوات، مثل الفوترة أو الاتفاقيات أو الاختبارات، يتم إنجازها على Vitanaland. يحدد Claude بالضبط أي منها ويوفر الرابط.
commerceConnect.stays3: كل ما ينشئه Claude يبدأ كمسودة مخفية. لا يظهر إلا بعد مراجعة عملك التجاري والموافقة عليه.
commerceConnect.stays4: لا تتم أي مدفوعات عبر Claude.
commerceConnect.tool_get_onboarding_status: عرض أعمالك التجارية ومدى تقدم الإعداد.
commerceConnect.tool_check_verification: Runs the automatic checks for your business.
commerceConnect.tool_connect_store: Recognises your online shop and connects it.
commerceConnect.tool_submit_for_verification: Submits your business for review after you agree.
commerceConnect.dataBody: Claude only sees and changes the data of your own businesses on Vitanaland, never member data. You can disconnect at any time in Claude.
commerceConnect.supportBody: Questions or problems? Write to us at
commerceConnect.ctaPortal: Set up in the portal instead
commerceConnect.privacyTitle: Privacy notice: Vitanaland connector for AI assistants
commerceConnect.privacyIntro: This notice explains what data the Vitanaland connector processes when you use it with Claude or another AI assistant. Everything else is covered by the Vitanaland privacy policy.
commerceConnect.privacyWhoBody: The controller is Exafy LTD, Al Khatem Tower, 15th Floor, ADGM, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates.
commerceConnect.privacyWhat1: Your Vitanaland account: user ID and email address, so we know who you are.
commerceConnect.privacyWhat2: The details of your business and your offers that you or Claude enter on your behalf.
commerceConnect.privacyWhat3: Logs of tool calls: which tool, when, and which fields were affected, but not their content.
commerceConnect.privacyWhyBody: Only to set up and run your business on Vitanaland, to keep the service secure and to prevent abuse.
commerceConnect.privacyShareBody: What you write to Claude and what Vitanaland returns to Claude is processed by your AI assistant's provider under its own terms. We do not sell data. We use processors for hosting and database to provide the service.
commerceConnect.privacyKeepBody: We keep your business data for as long as your business exists on Vitanaland. You can ask us to delete it.
commerceConnect.privacyRightsBody: You can ask for access, correction, deletion and restriction. Write to us at
